messages:
Devon: Hey team, gotta dash to the airport unexpectedly. Can someone pick up primary for the next ~4h? I'm currently primary for EU-embeds window. Sorry for the short notice.
Maya: I can take primary for the window, Devon. Are there any active mitigations or ongoing deploys I should know about? :wave: 
Devon: No deploys. We did see a small latency blip on embed-pool last hour but it recovered. I left a note in the runbook under 'embedding-pools -> recovery'.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: embeddings-service p95 latency 6500ms (threshold 2000ms). Incident ID: INC-2026-458.
Nora: copying. I'm nearby and can shadow for the first 30m while Maya ramps up. Anyone got quick perf context?
Maya: thanks Nora — I'll take primary. Devon — can you hand off any active alerts or customer threads?
Devon: Pinged support thread where a customer reported slower vector search; link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-9872. No escalation yet. Also left these quick pointers in case the p95 spikes again:
```
Runbook snippet: embeddings-service
- Check autoscale group: aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --auto-scaling-group-names embed-pool
- If p95 > 3s for >5m: scale +2, enable prefix-cache, route 20% traffic to quantized-variant
- Rollback recent model change: /deploy rollback embeddings:v2026-03-12
- Notify CS with template: "We are investigating increased latency; temporary mitigation in progress."
```
Liam: noted. If Maya takes primary, I'll keep secondary and monitor billing/throughput metrics.
Maya: got the runbook, thanks Devon. Nora, can you confirm you saw the autoscaling policy and the critical watchers?
Nora: confirmed. I verified alerting is pointed to oncall and escalation goes to paging + slack. Watchers: @eng-sre, @eng-runtime.
incident-bot: Update INC-2026-458: embeddings-service p95 returned to 1.9s after autoscale triggered. No customer-facing errors detected.
Maya: good. I'll keep primary duties and monitor for the next 4h. Devon — safe travels. I'll update rotation calendar and set a short handover note in ops doc.
Devon: thanks so much, Maya and Nora. One more: if you need to do a quick switchover command it's in the ops-tool: `opsctl handoff set-primary --user Maya --service embeds`
Maya: executing now, done. opsctl returned OK.
Liam: I'll watch error budget and cost bump when autoscale fires. If we see sustained autoscaling >15min, we'll open an incident channel and consider soft-throttle.
Nora: FYI added a one-line runbook pointer to the slack handoff thread and pinned it.
Maya: confirmed primary swap in calendar and pinged CS with a short note: "Temporary performance mitigation applied; monitoring closely."
Devon: Appreciate the coverage — leaving my mobile on if anything critical. :phone:
Maya: Alright team, primary/secondary rotation confirmed: Primary=Maya, Secondary=Liam, Shadow=Nora. I'll escalate if latency trends upward. :thumbsup:
